tasks.title: 301 Redirect /suite-rentals/ to /open-your-salon/ + Fix 3,216 Missing Trailing-Slash Template Links (NEW-10, Item 36.0, NEW-06)
tasks.title_en: 301 Redirect /suite-rentals/ to /open-your-salon/ + Fix 3,216 Missing Trailing-Slash Template Links (NEW-10, Item 36.0, NEW-06)
tasks.rootCause: 🎯 Dev Ticket Standard: 1. SYMPTOM: (A) https://imagestudios.co/suite-rentals/ returns 404. (B) Screaming Frog flagged 3,216 internal 301 redirects (45.5% of site): 2,862 /pros/ links and 354 /bios/ links missing trailing slashes. 2. ROOT CAUSE: Missing server rewrite and template link helpers omit trailingslashit(). 3. ARCHITECTURE: Nginx rewrite + CPT single templates.
tasks.businessImpact: Recovers organic equity on the legacy commercial URL /suite-rentals/ and eliminates 3,216 internal 301 redirect hops in one quick template deployment.
tasks.technicalInstructions:
1. In Nginx / Yoast Redirects, add permanent 301 redirect:
   rewrite ^/suite-rentals/?$ https://imagestudios.co/open-your-salon/ permanent;
2. In /wp-content/themes/image-studios/ templates (single-studio_locations.php, page-locations.php), wrap dynamic profile and location links in trailingslashit():
   <a href="<?php echo esc_url( trailingslashit( $pro_url ) ); ?>">
acceptanceCriteria: All /pros/, /bios/, and location links in DOM include a trailing slash (/).
